terminal_clerk.text: The ferry to Stromness sails from the quay outside. Talk to Skipper Morag at the gangway. She'll tell you about the weather. At length.
Ninety minutes across, past the Old Man of Hoy. In a big sea the boat goes up, then it goes down, then it thinks about it and goes sideways.

orkney_bound.text: Off to Orkney for the Ring of Brodgar and Skara Brae! Five thousand years old, older than Stonehenge's big stones.
My guidebook says 'dress for four seasons in one day'. I've packed for five. The fifth is called 'Pentland Firth'.
